title: Data center cooling anomaly in Rack 4
description: Temperature sensors in the north-end aisle are spiking past 32°C. The fans in the row are sluggish and one chassis is reporting thermal throttling. Need an immediate site visit to check the HVAC manifold.
resolution: Replaced faulty fan tray in Row B and adjusted thermostat setpoints to balance airflow load.

title: Subnet reachability dropping intermittently
description: Our dev-stack subnet (10.44.x.x) is flapping. Packets are getting dropped at the core gateway every 10-15 minutes. It’s killing our build pipelines.
resolution: Identified a duplicate IP assignment on a misconfigured legacy printer; updated DHCP reservations to exclude the range.

title: Core switch uplink failing SFP diagnostic
description: Port 49 on the main distribution switch is logging CRC errors and flapping light levels. The SFP+ transceiver looks discolored.
resolution: Swapped out the defective SFP+ module and cleaned the fiber optic interface patch cable.

title: Backup job stalled on Storage Array 2
description: The SAN array is throwing I/O timeout warnings. The daily incremental backup has been stuck at 4% for four hours.
resolution: Increased the LUN queue depth on the host side and cleared orphaned lock files from the volume manager.

title: UPS battery fault alert - Site B
description: We received an automated SNMP trap indicating 'Battery Capacity Low' for the UPS unit in the server room. The web interface says it’s at 12% health.
resolution: Scheduled emergency replacement of battery strings; UPS verified operational and self-test passed.

title: VLAN tagging mismatch on trunk ports
description: Virtual machines on Host 07 are losing connectivity to the storage VLAN. It looks like the tagged packets are being dropped by the physical switch port.
resolution: Corrected native VLAN mismatch on the physical uplink port to match the distributed switch configuration.

title: SSL Certificate expiration warning
description: The load balancer for our primary public portal is alerting that the intermediate CA certificate expires in 48 hours.
resolution: Renewed and deployed the updated CA bundle to the load balancer virtual server pool.

title: Physical layer instability in the wiring closet
description: Several users in the West Wing are complaining about connection drops. I suspect a loose patch cable or a port going bad on the edge switch.
resolution: Re-punched down the Cat6 cable on the patch panel and replaced a damaged patch cord.

title: Power supply unit (PSU) redundancy alert
description: Server SVR-01 is alerting that power supply #2 has lost its AC input. I’ve checked the PDU and it seems to have power.
resolution: Replaced faulty power cable connecting the PSU to the PDU; redundancy state restored.

title: DNS resolution latency spikes
description: Internal DNS queries are taking upwards of 2000ms. It feels like our recursive forwarders are under heavy load or routing traffic incorrectly.
resolution: Flushed the DNS cache and optimized the upstream forwarder list to bypass a congested secondary ISP node.

title: KVM over IP module unresponsive
description: The integrated management card on the core router has locked up. We can't reach the serial console to push a configuration change.
resolution: Performed a hard power cycle of the management card via the main chassis power supply reset.

title: Fiber path attenuation detected
description: The link between the head office and the remote site is showing high dB loss. We are at the threshold of losing carrier signal.
resolution: Cleaned the fiber bulkhead at the demarcation point; signal levels returned to acceptable nominal range.

title: Unexpected reboot of VM host
description: Host-04 went down twice in the last 24 hours. The BMC log shows a 'Kernel Panic' triggered by a hardware driver conflict.
resolution: Updated HBA firmware and rolled back the NIC driver to the stable vendor-recommended version.

title: DHCP Scope exhaustion
description: The main office range is completely full. New devices are failing to pull an IP address. We need to expand the scope.
resolution: Expanded the DHCP scope range from /24 to /23 and increased lease times for guest devices.

title: External storage connectivity timeout
description: The NAS is intermittently dropping sessions. Logs show 'Target dropped connection' errors during heavy read operations.
resolution: Configured Jumbo Frames (MTU 9000) across the storage network fabric to alleviate packet fragmentation.

title: Patching schedule conflict
description: The automatic firmware update on the aggregation switches is scheduled during our core production hours. Needs to be moved to the weekend.
resolution: Rescheduled the orchestration task in the management console to 02:00 Saturday.

title: Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) loop alert
description: The core switch is logging 'BPDU Guard' triggers on multiple ports. It looks like someone plugged a desktop switch into two wall jacks.
resolution: Identified the rogue switch in cubicle 4B, disconnected it, and educated the end-user on network policy.

title: CRM Dashboard Widget Won't Load Data
description: I'm looking at the 'Quarterly Revenue' widget on the main dashboard, but it's just spinning indefinitely. Everything else in the CRM loads fine.
resolution: Cleared browser cache and forced a refresh of the API token, which restored the widget data feed.

title: Document Editor Formatting Glitch
description: Every time I paste text from a PDF into the internal editor, it inserts a random hidden character that breaks the page layout. Super frustrating.
resolution: Advised user to use 'Paste as Plain Text' (Ctrl+Shift+V) to avoid carrying over incompatible formatting codes.

title: Inventory App Sync Loop
description: My mobile inventory scanner is stuck in a 'Syncing...' loop. It's been 20 minutes and it won't let me process the new shipment incoming.
resolution: Identified a hung process in the background. Force-closed the app, cleared the local cache database, and re-initiated sync.

title: SSO Authentication Timeout
description: Keep getting booted from the Analytics Portal every 5 minutes. It says 'Token Expired' even though I'm actively using the tool.
resolution: System clock on the user's workstation was out of sync with the domain controller by 4 minutes, causing premature token invalidation.

title: Export Failure in Reporting Tool
description: Tried to export a 2,000-row table to CSV. The app just crashes to the desktop without an error code every single time.
resolution: Increased the virtual memory allowance for the application and updated the .NET framework runtime.

title: Access Denied on Project Folder
description: I've been working in the DesignApp all morning, but suddenly I don't have 'Write' permissions on the Shared Project Library anymore.
resolution: User was inadvertently moved to a different Active Directory security group; restored membership to 'Design_Contributors'.

title: Image Upload Error: 413 Payload Too Large
description: Tried to upload a high-res mockup for the client, but the app keeps yelling at me about the file size. It's only 8MB!
resolution: Adjusted the application's max_upload_size configuration from 5MB to 20MB in the server settings.

title: Application UI Scaling Issue
description: On my 4K monitor, the buttons in the Payroll App are tiny—practically invisible. Can I zoom this in?
resolution: Enabled 'High DPI Scaling Override' in the application compatibility properties.

title: Database Connection Timeout
description: The Finance app is throwing 'SQL Error 504: Gateway Timeout' when I try to run the month-end reconciliation report.
resolution: Optimized the backend SQL stored procedure; index fragmentation was causing the query to time out.

title: Spellcheck Language Mismatch
description: The editor keeps flagging every word as misspelled because it's defaulting to French. I need it back in US English.
resolution: Updated the global configuration settings to set the default dictionary to 'en-US' for the specific user profile.

title: Multi-Factor Prompt Not Appearing
description: I log into the HR portal, enter my password, and it just stops. No MFA notification, no code, just a blank white screen.
resolution: The MFA integration service was down; restarted the service and cleared cached auth sessions.

title: Batch Processing Stalled
description: I queued 50 video files for compression in the MediaTool. It processed the first 3 and just stopped cold.
resolution: The temp directory had insufficient disk space; cleared the temp files and restarted the batch queue.

title: Missing Menu Options
description: My colleague has an 'Admin Tools' tab in the app, but mine is completely hidden. I need to approve his request.
resolution: Granted the user the 'App_Manager' permission flag via the internal permissions management console.

title: Plugin Incompatibility Warning
description: Every time I launch the CodeEditor, it warns me that the 'Git-Link' plugin is incompatible with the current version. It's slowing everything down.
resolution: Disabled the legacy plugin and installed the updated 'Git-Link Pro' version from the marketplace.

title: Keyboard Shortcut Conflict
description: The new app update is intercepting the 'Ctrl+S' command, so I can't save my work in other windows if the app is open.
resolution: Configured the application to 'Ignore Global Hotkeys' via the advanced preferences menu.

title: Unexpected Logout During Save
description: I was just about to save my progress, and the app forced a log out. Now my changes are gone.
resolution: The session duration timeout was set too short for data-heavy tasks; increased the session limit to 4 hours.

title: Font Rendering Issue
description: The app is displaying all text in a weird blocky font that's illegible. Looks like a corrupted font file.
resolution: Purged the local font cache and repaired the installation of the proprietary application font pack.

title: Unrecognized MFA push notification received during off-hours
description: I just got a notification on my Duo app asking me to approve a login attempt while I'm currently on PTO. I did not trigger this. What do I do?
resolution: Invalidated existing session tokens, forced global password reset, and reviewed logs to confirm a geo-blocked IP attempt; blocked originating subnet.

title: Department file share permissions suddenly wide open
description: It looks like the 'Executive-Confidential' folder is now visible to the entire 'Interns' AD group. This happened after the morning backup script ran.
resolution: Corrected inherited NTFS permissions and audited Group Policy Objects to identify a misconfigured script; restored restricted access levels.

title: USB device blocked but user insists it's mission critical
description: System endpoint protection nuked my thumb drive again. It’s a Kingston encrypted drive with legal discovery files. Can we white-list this VID/PID?
resolution: Verified drive integrity in a sandbox environment and added the device to the exception policy for the specific user's hardware ID.

title: Suspected phishing link clicked in internal email
description: I clicked a link in an email that looked like it came from IT regarding a password expiry. It took me to a login page that looked off, so I closed it immediately.
resolution: Isolated workstation from network, scanned for malicious scripts, verified no credentials were harvested, and cleared browser cache.

title: VPN connection drops every 5 minutes with 'Security Violation'
description: Ever since the latest ZTNA client update, my connection to the server is getting killed instantly. The log says 'Endpoint posture assessment failed'.
resolution: Discovered the update reverted firewall exceptions; re-applied policy and updated client signatures to recognize current OS build.

title: Lost company-issued laptop
description: I left my machine at the airport terminal. It has the BitLocker recovery key written in a sticky note on the lid. Please advise.
resolution: Issued remote wipe command via MDM, revoked device certificates, and triggered the emergency offboarding workflow.

title: Strange process 'svchost.exe' running from AppData
description: My computer is running at 90% CPU. I looked in Task Manager and saw a svchost.exe running from my local user profile folder. This feels wrong.
resolution: Identified malicious payload masquerading as system process; quarantined file, cleaned registry keys, and performed full rootkit scan.

title: Requesting temporary elevation for software installation
description: Need to install a packet sniffer for a networking lab assignment. Requesting local admin rights for the next 2 hours.
resolution: Denied request for global admin; provided instructions on using the approved software portal to deploy the tool in a virtualized container.

title: Potential data exfiltration attempt logged
description: DLP alert triggered for user 'jsmith'. Large volumes of encrypted zip files were moved to a personal cloud storage site at 3:00 AM.
resolution: Account suspended pending investigation; initiated forensic imaging of the user's local drive and reviewed egress logs.

title: Unable to access HR portal due to certificate error
description: Every time I go to the payroll site, Chrome screams at me about the SSL certificate being invalid. I need my paystub today.
resolution: Discovered expired root CA on client machine; deployed updated CA bundle via SCCM to resolve the trust chain.

title: Email account sending spam to the whole company
description: I'm getting reports that my account is sending out 'get rich quick' emails. I haven't sent anything since breakfast.
resolution: Detected compromised API key used for SMTP relay; rotated all account keys and scrubbed outbound queue of malicious messages.

title: Physical security badge issue at lobby
description: My badge isn't triggering the turnstiles. I can hear a weird clicking sound when I tap the reader.
resolution: Validated badge against the door controller database; replaced hardware reader at lobby entrance due to faulty antenna.

title: Application whitelist blocking necessary legacy app
description: Our accounting team uses an old DOS-based app that keeps getting blocked by the new EDR agent. It's flagging it as 'untrusted code'.
resolution: Created a hash-based exclusion for the legacy binary and moved it to a secure, restricted subnet with no external internet access.

title: Suspicious login attempt from international IP
description: I got an automated email saying my account logged in from Moscow. I’m sitting in my office in Chicago right now.
resolution: Forced password reset, cleared all O365 active sessions, and implemented conditional access policy requiring local country login only.

title: Encrypted files found on shared drive
description: I opened our project folder and all the Excel files have a .crypt extension now. What is going on?
resolution: Confirmed ransomware infection on source workstation; disconnected compromised share, initiated restoration from immutable backups.

title: Request to bypass web filter for YouTube
description: Marketing needs access to YouTube to upload promotional videos, but the current web filtering policy blocks all video streaming sites.
resolution: Created a dedicated OU with modified web filtering group policy that allows access to specific domains for the Marketing team only.

title: Service account password rotation failure
description: The automated task for the SQL database failed because the service account password expired. It says 'Access Denied'.
resolution: Manually synced service account credentials across cluster nodes and updated the Task Scheduler config to use a managed service account.

title: Stale materialized view preventing morning reporting sync
description: The 'daily_sales_rollup' view hasn't refreshed since 03:00 UTC. BI team is looking at empty dashboards.
resolution: Manually triggered the pg_cron job and cleared the stale cache lockfile.

title: Application timeout during heavy blob retrieval
description: Users are reporting 504 errors when trying to download PDF invoices from the history tab. Looks like the DB connection pool is hitting a ceiling.
resolution: Increased max_connections and tuned the read-replica timeout settings to handle long-running binary streams.

title: Index fragmentation causing full table scans
description: Query performance on the 'users' table has degraded by 400% over the last week. EXPLAIN ANALYZE shows massive disk I/O.
resolution: Executed a concurrent REINDEX on the primary ID and email columns.

title: Stuck transaction blocking DDL operations
description: An orphaned process ID 4829 is holding a lock on the 'inventory' table. Cannot run the schema migration to add the new 'location_id' column.
resolution: Terminated the idle-in-transaction backend process and restarted the migration script.

title: Production backup failure: Disk pressure
description: Automated nightly pg_dump crashed at 85% completion. Error: 'No space left on device'.
resolution: Purged logs older than 30 days from the backup mount and expanded the EBS volume size.

title: Deadlock detected in checkout service
description: Service logs show 'DeadlockFoundException' frequently during peak traffic. Transactions 0x4f2 and 0x9a1 are fighting over row locks.
resolution: Refactored the application code to ensure consistent resource locking order across all transactional modules.

title: Character encoding mismatch on legacy data import
description: New data ingested into the 'client_notes' field is showing garbled UTF-8 characters (e.g., ).
resolution: Converted column collation to utf8mb4_unicode_ci and scrubbed invalid byte sequences using a regex script.

title: ReadOnly replica lagging significantly behind master
description: Replica B is 45 minutes behind. This is causing inconsistent data visibility for our global support agents.
resolution: Identified a heavy long-running write transaction on master; optimized query to prevent WAL playback blockage.

title: Forgotten credentials for dev environment root
description: The lead dev needs access to the 'staging_sandbox' DB but the root password has been lost following the last rotation.
resolution: Reset the database administrative password via single-user mode and updated the team vault.

title: Connection leaks in microservices layer
description: DB connections are hitting the 1000 limit within minutes of restarting the gateway service. App logs show 'Pool exhausted'.
resolution: Fixed missing close() blocks in the repository service logic to ensure connections are returned to the pool.

title: Slow query alert: sequential scan on customer_id
description: A query filtering by customer_id is taking 12 seconds. It should be indexed, but performance monitoring suggests otherwise.
resolution: Discovered the index was marked 'INVALID' due to a failed previous migration; re-built index concurrently.

title: Out of memory (OOM) killer invoked on DB process
description: The DB node rebooted unexpectedly. Kernel logs show OOM killer terminated the postgres process.
resolution: Adjusted work_mem and shared_buffers to match the current RAM allocation and prevented swapping.

title: Foreign key constraint violation on bulk upload
description: Users are unable to bulk-upload assets. Error: 'violates foreign key constraint on parent_folder_id'.
resolution: Cleaned up dangling orphaned folder references and corrected the import CSV file structure.

title: Disk latency spikes impacting write performance
description: Cloud watch metrics show IOPS hitting the limit for the DB volume, causing high p99 latency during peak hours.
resolution: Provisioned additional IOPS and migrated indices to a dedicated high-throughput volume.

title: Table bloat affecting storage efficiency
description: The 'logs' table is taking up 400GB, but only 100GB of that is actual active data.
resolution: Performed a VACUUM FULL during the maintenance window to reclaim unused space.

title: Audit log table reaching partition limit
description: The 'audit_2023_Q4' table partition is nearly full. We need to plan for the next quarter.
resolution: Created the 'audit_2024_Q1' partition and set up the trigger function for auto-routing new entries.

title: Cannot drop user due to dependent object ownership
description: Trying to offboard a developer's access, but 'DROP USER' fails because they 'own' several application schemas.
resolution: Reassigned schema ownership to the 'app_owner' service account and successfully dropped the user.

title: NFS mount points turning stale after midnight
description: Our /data-mount directory becomes unresponsive exactly at 00:05. Running 'ls' hangs indefinitely. Looks like a cron job might be causing a kernel-level lockout.
resolution: Adjusted the automount timeout settings and patched the client-side NFS kernel module to resolve race conditions during log rotation.

title: SAN fabric latency spikes on Node-04
description: Users are reporting sub-second freezes when accessing the SQL cluster. Checking the fabric switches, I see cyclic buffer-to-buffer credit depletion on port 4/12.
resolution: Replaced a degraded SFP+ transceiver and re-routed heavy traffic to a secondary path to alleviate switch buffer congestion.

title: Snapshot retention policy failing on Tier-2
description: The daily snap-shots aren't pruning as scheduled. We are currently at 98% utilization and I'm worried we'll hit read-only mode by tomorrow morning.
resolution: Manually purged expired snapshots via CLI and corrected a syntax error in the metadata management script that was preventing the cleanup process from executing.

title: SSD endurance warning: Drive 09 in Shelf B
description: The alert manager just screamed about an SSD wear-leveling threshold breach. It's currently at 1% life remaining.
resolution: Performed a proactive drive swap during the maintenance window and verified RAID reconstruction success.

title: iSCSI multipath path failure
description: We are getting 'path down' errors on our ESXi hosts. Connectivity is fluttering between the storage controller and the VMWare environment.
resolution: Identified a misconfigured jumbo frame setting on the upstream switch that was dropping packets for oversized iSCSI frames.

title: Slow write speeds on Archive Array
description: Writing a 50GB tarball takes three times longer than it did last month. Reads are fine, but writes are crawling.
resolution: Identified fragmented parity blocks. Executed a background defragmentation/re-striping operation to optimize write head latency.

title: Object storage bucket returning 403 Forbidden
description: My dev environment can't reach the S3 bucket even though the IAM role is set to FullAccess. It worked yesterday.
resolution: Reset the bucket policy permissions which had been corrupted by a recent Terraform misconfiguration.

title: LUN masking visibility issue
description: The new Windows server doesn't see the LUN presented to it from the SAN. It's configured correctly on the fabric, but Windows Disk Management is empty.
resolution: Added the server's WWN to the whitelist in the storage array's zoning configuration.

title: Thin provisioning alarm: Pool oversubscription
description: The virtual storage pool says it has 10TB of free space, but the physical reality is that we've run out of raw blocks. Please advise before we crash.
resolution: Expanded the physical disk shelf and extended the LUN group to recover from the over-provisioning warning.

title: Encryption key rotation error
description: Attempting to rotate the volume encryption keys failed with a 'TIMEOUT_KMS_PROVIDER' error. The data is still accessible, but I'm nervous about the security compliance.
resolution: Renewed the SSL certificate for the KMS provider and successfully re-synced the storage array's connection to the vault.

title: Veeam backup target off-line
description: The repository server isn't mounting the backup target. Trying to mount manually returns 'Incorrect function'.
resolution: Refreshed the iSCSI target session and restarted the Windows Storage Management service.

title: Inode exhaustion on legacy filer
description: The file system claims it has 200GB free, but I can't create new files. The error is 'No space left on device'.
resolution: Deleted orphaned temporary files and increased the inode count limit on the filesystem.

title: Deduplication ratio plummeting
description: Our backup dedupe ratio has dropped from 4:1 down to 1.1:1. Is there a corruption issue or did the data type change?
resolution: Analyzed the backup stream and found a misconfigured agent that was encrypting files before the backup, preventing effective deduplication.

title: Storage controller heat alarm
description: Physical sensor 0x04 on Controller B is reporting 85C. The internal fans aren't spinning up.
resolution: Replaced the failed fan module and checked the thermal paste on the controller CPU.

title: Cloud Tiering latency affecting app performance
description: Our application is configured to move cold data to the cloud. When it tries to fetch it, the app hangs for minutes.
resolution: Increased the cache hit threshold in the storage gateway software to keep frequently accessed objects on local SSDs longer.

title: NFS mount locking issues
description: Multiple clients are trying to edit the same CSV file on the mount, but the file locking isn't preventing collisions.
resolution: Enabled 'nolock' option on client mount commands and confirmed the rpc.statd service was running on all nodes.

title: Unable to resize volume
description: Getting an 'Operation not permitted' error when trying to grow a partition in the web GUI. I have admin rights.
resolution: Closed a dangling CLI session that held a lock on the LUN metadata and successfully performed the resize via the backend shell.

title: Latency spikes during video conferencing
description: Voice and video calls drop packets consistently between 2 PM and 4 PM. Desktop app reports 'high jitter' regardless of which floor the user is on.
resolution: Identified high bandwidth usage from a rogue automated backup script running on a server; scheduled backup moved to off-peak hours.

title: Guest Wi-Fi portal loop
description: Visitors connecting to 'Guest_Net' are stuck in a redirect loop after entering credentials. Browser keeps timing out on the authentication handshake.
resolution: Cleared stale MAC entries from the captive portal controller’s cache and increased the session timeout limit.

title: Departmental printer unreachable
description: Floor 3 printer (HP-LaserJet-99) is offline for all users. Cannot ping the static IP, though it shows as connected on the switch port.
resolution: Reassigned a conflicting static IP that was inadvertently assigned to a new laptop via DHCP; reserved printer IP in the scope.

title: VPN handshake failure
description: Remote users unable to establish a secure tunnel. Logs show 'IKE Phase 1 negotiation failed' for 40% of the remote workforce.
resolution: Renewed the expired SSL certificate on the VPN concentrator and force-pushed a client configuration update.

title: Intermittent packet loss in Server Room B
description: Monitoring tools indicate periodic drops on uplink to switch 4-B. Physical check shows no signs of damage, but CRC errors are climbing.
resolution: Replaced faulty SFP module and fiber patch cable connecting the distribution switch.

title: DNS resolution timeouts
description: Several internal apps are failing to resolve hostnames. 'nslookup' returns 'Server Failure' for our internal domain suffixes.
resolution: Resolved circular dependency in DNS forwarders by resetting the primary forwarder to the internal root hint.

title: Switch port flapping in lobby
description: The ethernet port for the lobby kiosk keeps resetting. Lights blink rapidly for a few seconds every 10 minutes.
resolution: Disabled PortFast on the uplink, identified a faulty network cable causing an STP loop, and replaced the cable.

title: Unauthorized rogue AP detected
description: Security scanner flagged an unknown SSID broadcasting near the HR office. Signal strength is very high.
resolution: Located a personal Wi-Fi range extender plugged into a wall port by an employee; device removed and user warned.

title: Inability to map network drives
description: Users on the accounting VLAN report 'Path not found' when trying to access the Finance share. Access to the internet works fine.
resolution: Reapplied missing firewall rule on the perimeter appliance that was blocking SMB traffic during the last firmware update.

title: VLAN tagging mismatch
description: The new VOIP phones are not pulling an IP address. They seem to be stuck on the default VLAN instead of the Voice VLAN.
resolution: Configured the switchport as 'trunk' with the correct voice VLAN ID to allow the phones to tag their own traffic.

title: SSL decryption causing site blocks
description: Multiple users reporting that banking websites are showing 'Untrusted Connection' errors despite having valid certs.
resolution: Updated the root certificate on the firewall’s proxy server to match the latest security standards.

title: Extreme Wi-Fi congestion in boardroom
description: During meetings, connection is unusable. RSSI is fine, but throughput is near zero when more than 10 people connect.
resolution: Adjusted channel width from 80MHz to 40MHz to reduce co-channel interference and tuned min-bitrate settings.

title: DHCP scope exhaustion
description: New devices cannot join the network. They get a 169.254.x.x address. DHCP server is showing 0 available addresses.
resolution: Expanded the DHCP scope subnet from /24 to /23 and cleaned up abandoned leases.

title: Slow file transfers to NAS
description: Copying files to the local NAS takes 3x longer than usual. Observed speeds hovering around 10Mbps on gigabit hardware.
resolution: Detected duplex mismatch on the NAS port; forced the port to 1000/Full rather than autonegotiate.

title: Firewall configuration push failed
description: Cannot apply the latest policy to the perimeter gateway. Dashboard returns 'Syntax error in rule set'.
resolution: Removed a legacy object reference from the rule set that was orphaned during the database migration.

title: PoE+ power budget exceeded
description: Security cameras connected to Switch 7 are randomly powering off. We added three new cameras today.
resolution: Calculated total power draw; installed an external power injector for the additional cameras to stay within the switch budget.

title: Latency on SIP trunks
description: Users are complaining about 'robotic' audio on outbound calls. WAN utilization is low, but QOS tags seem to be ignored.
resolution: Re-configured DSCP mapping on the edge router to ensure voice traffic is prioritized correctly over standard data.

title: Onboarding block: New hire cannot authenticate to SSO portal
description: User 'j.doe' joined this morning. When attempting to log into the Okta dashboard, they receive 'Invalid User Context' error despite being provisioned in AD.
resolution: User account was not assigned to the 'Global_All_Staff' security group. Added user to group and forced a sync.

title: Stale permissions for legacy database
description: I moved from Marketing to Finance last month but I still have read-write access to the 'Campaign_Assets' share. Needs to be revoked for compliance.
resolution: Removed user from 'Marketing_Data_ReadWrite' AD group and cleared local network credentials cache.

title: VPN MFA loop: Authenticator app sync issue
description: Keep getting stuck in a redirect loop when trying to connect to the corp VPN. The Microsoft Authenticator app approves the push, but the browser just times out.
resolution: Cleared 'Registered Devices' for the user in Entra ID; prompted user to re-register the device as a new MFA factor.

title: Jira access escalation required
description: I'm a lead developer but currently only have 'Reporter' permissions on the SRE board. Need 'Admin' access to modify workflow transitions.
resolution: Granted project-level administrative rights after verifying approval from the SRE Manager via ticket attachment.

title: Administrative lockout on workstation
description: Tried to update the local printer driver, but the system is asking for domain admin credentials which I don't have. Can I get a temporary exception?
resolution: Denied request for local admin. Pushed the updated driver package remotely via Intune instead.

title: External contractor access expiration notice
description: I am working with our external vendor 'TechFlow'. Their access expired yesterday, but they still have tickets in the queue. Can we extend the account for 48 hours?
resolution: Extended account expiration date by 48 hours. Notified manager to formalize the extension if further time is needed.

title: O365 Mailbox Sharing Permission Errors
description: I'm trying to add the 'info@company.com' shared mailbox to my Outlook, but I get 'Cannot display the folder' error.
resolution: User had 'Read' permission but was missing 'Folder Visible' rights. Updated permissions via Exchange Admin Center.

title: Github organization removal request
description: I have left the frontend team. Please remove me from the 'Frontend-Repo-Private' group to prevent me from seeing proprietary code.
resolution: Removed user from the GitHub organization team 'Frontend_Developers'.

title: Sudden Access Denied to NetApp storage
description: Our team cannot mount the Z-drive. It was working at 9 AM, but now everyone on the floor gets a 'Permission Denied' prompt.
resolution: The security group mapping the Z-drive was accidentally moved to an OU with block-inheritance enabled. Reverted GPO changes.

title: Request for Sudo access on staging server
description: Need to run a script on 'staging-web-01' that requires elevated privileges. Can you add me to the sudoers file?
resolution: Added user to the 'sudo' group specifically for 'staging-web-01' with password enforcement enabled.

title: Mismatched display name in Global Address List
description: My legal name changed, but the GAL still shows my old name. This is causing confusion during meetings.
resolution: Updated 'DisplayName' and 'Alias' attributes in Active Directory; forced sync to O365.

title: Self-service password reset failure
description: The SSPR portal keeps saying 'We could not verify your identity' even though I'm answering the security questions correctly.
resolution: Account was in a 'Locked' status due to too many failed attempts. Unlocked the AD account and reset the password token.

title: Need access to Confidential HR Folders
description: I am the new HR manager and need access to the 'Payroll_FY24' folder in SharePoint. My predecessor's access should be revoked as well.
resolution: Mapped requested permissions. Removed predecessor from the 'HR_Sensitive_Access' security group.

title: Mobile device non-compliance lockout
description: My phone says my account is blocked because I'm not running the latest iOS. I need access to my corporate email ASAP.
resolution: Provided user with the instructions to update iOS. Issued a temporary 24-hour compliance grace period via Intune.

title: Read-only access requested for logs
description: As a data analyst, I need to query the central log bucket, but I don't need write access.
resolution: Granted IAM role 'Storage Object Viewer' to the user on the specific log bucket.

title: Revoking access for terminated employee
description: Employee 'm.smith' has been terminated effective immediately. Please disable all access across AD, Slack, and Jira.
resolution: Disabled AD account, revoked Okta session, and deactivated Slack/Jira profiles.

title: App access permission request - Tableau
description: My team is migrating to Tableau for dashboards. I need 'Viewer' access to the 'Executive_Sales' workbook.
resolution: Added user to 'Tableau_Sales_Viewer' AD group which syncs permissions to the Tableau server.
